Any tool, server, test or document that needs an id->name mapping must read THIS file.

The tsv only ever satisfied condition (a) below (hash match).  Nobody had checked (b).
tools/pf_vital_name_thunk_static.py checked (b) for all 327 by matching the registration
thunk as a raw byte template (no disassembler), and sorted them:

AMBIGUOUS   37  see below
NO_THUNK    15  literal exists, no thunk anywhere claims it

WHY THE OTHER 54 WERE KEPT OUT / ทำไม 54 ตัวไม่ได้เข้า
* 37 AMBIGUOUS: each has exactly ONE well-formed thunk, but its literal is ALSO pushed by
a string-table constructor around 0x0042xxxx (push <lit>; lea ecx,[esp+N]; call
ds:[0xC3B480]).  Rule (4)(b) below says 'the SINGLE push of that literal'.  They fail
that clause as written, so they stay out.  Admitting them means amending (4)(b) on
purpose, in a round of its own - not quietly relaxing a matcher to get a bigger number.

* 15 NO_THUNK: the name is in the image but no registration thunk exists for it (mostly
Community_* / Express_* server-to-server classes the client never registers).
* 2 NO_LITERAL: no standalone NUL-terminated identifier literal at all.

NOT PROVEN, ON PURPOSE / สิ่งที่ 'ยัง' ไม่ได้พิสูจน์
A PROVEN row says: this exact name registers this exact id-slot in the client binary.
It does NOT say the id was ever seen on the wire.  The pinned golden corpus
(docs/PF_CAPTURE_CORPUS.json) carries only 10 distinct wire ids, all of which this table
already held before round 85, so all 246 folded entries have in_golden_corpus = false.
That field was computed from the corpus, never guessed.

current/pf_login_game_server_v141.py is a FROZEN DELIVERY SNAPSHOT written by the previous
AI (Codex): a from-scratch server derived by reverse-engineering the client. It is NOT raw
evidence and it is NOT 'the original server' - the original server was never published and
has been shut down for years. Its one remaining job is to be the reference we diff the
rewrite against, so that we can tell whether we have drifted. That comparison is only
meaningful if the snapshot never moves. That - not evidentiary status - is why it is
byte-frozen (sha256 guard in tools/verify_hypothesis_ledger.py).

(4) HOW TO ADD A NEW NAME / จะเพิ่มชื่อใหม่ทำยังไง
ADD IT HERE. ONLY HERE. Never in v141, never in a second table.
เพิ่มที่ไฟล์นี้เท่านั้น ห้ามเติมใน v141 (แม้จะดูเป็นที่ที่ 'เคยชิน')
A new entry is admissible only when BOTH hold:
(a) HASH MATCH - wire_id(name) == id under the round-62 algorithm in hash_algorithm below.
tests/test_vital_names_table.py enforces this on every entry, so a wrong name is red
immediately.
(b) LITERAL -> SLOT EVIDENCE - the name exists as a unique identifier-style string literal
in GameClient/GameClient.local.bin, and the single push of that literal sits in the
round-62 registration thunk (push <lit>; call 0x89C080; mov ecx,eax; call 0x89BD00;
mov word ptr [<id-slot>], ax; ret). Record that id-slot VA in 'id_slot_va' and cite
the finding document in 'evidence'.
Names inherited from v141 are grandfathered: their evidence pointer is the v141 NAMES entry
itself, and they still have to pass the hash check.

hash_algorithm.summary: uint16 id = ( sum over i of (signed char)name[i] * (i+1) ) mod 2^16
pseudocode: c = byte - 256 if byte >= 128 else byte     # movsx di, byte -> signed char
s += c * (i + 1)                            # imul di, bx    -> 1-based index
return s & 0xFFFF                               # mov ax, dx; ret 4
